description: Figure 3 presents the domain distribution of the AttrEval-GenSearch test set, encompassing a total of 12 domains. The chart is a pie chart with slices representing the proportion of samples from each domain. The domains and their approximate proportions are as follows: Daily Life (24.3%), AI/NLP Research (24.3%), Business (8.3%), History (8.3%), Geography (5.7%), Science & Fin. (5.7%), Game/Anime (1.2%), Econ. & Pol. (1.2%), Travel (1.2%), Food & Drink (1.2%), and other domains labeled as “X” and “XX” each representing 1.2% of the total. A legend is included, associating each color with a specific domain. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion, though this is not strictly maintained throughout.
